title: Sigma Canonical PRD
description: CLI-agnostic canonical PRD schema. Authored once per PRD, then transformed by per-CLI emitters into Claude /goal bundles, Codex /goal bundles, and Droid mission.md + features.json + validation-contract.md bundles. The `goal` block feeds /goal-style autonomous execution (Claude Code v2.1.139+, Codex /goal). The `mission` block feeds Factory Droid's mission/features.json schema. The `slices` block lets large PRDs be split into context-window-sized sub-goals. See docs/strategy/2026-05-23-cli-native-prd-upgrade.md for full design rationale.

prd_id.description: Stable PRD identifier. Accepts either F-numeric (e.g. F11.001) for new PRDs or legacy PRD-SLUG (e.g. PRD-CLI-CLEANUP) for back-compat. Emitters use this as the dispatch filename stem.

title.description: Human-readable PRD title. Surface in dashboards and emitted bundle headers.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug used in emitter filenames and as a stable URL fragment. Required by all emitters.

wave.description: Optional sprint wave grouping (integer or string label).

dependencies.description: Other PRD IDs that must be complete before this one starts.

goal.description: Autonomous-execution metadata consumed by Claude /goal and Codex /goal emitters. The {objective, stopping_condition} pair gets concatenated with surrounding context when emitted; aim for <=300 chars each so the combined prompt fits Claude's 4000-char /goal limit with headroom.

objective.description: Single-sentence statement of what success looks like. Keep <=300 chars to fit /goal limits when concatenated with context.

stopping_condition.description: Measurable, transcript-observable proof of done. Must be checkable from the agent's own output (test name, file diff, command exit code). Keep <=300 chars.

files_to_read_first.description: Repo-relative paths the agent should read before editing. Codex /goal expects this front-loaded; Claude emitter places it in <context> block.

proof_commands.description: Literal shell commands that prove progress. Used by stopping_condition checkers and emitted into the Done-when section of each bundle.

max_turns.description: Upper bound on agent turns for /goal execution. Defaults to 20 when omitted by emitters.

out_of_scope.description: Explicit non-goals. Emitted into each bundle as guardrails.

mission.description: Factory-Droid-compatible mission metadata. Drives mission.md + features.json emission. `expected_behavior` is the BDD scenario block reference; `fulfills` IDs MUST match assertion IDs in the companion validation-contract.md (emitter-time check, not schema-time).

milestone.description: Milestone grouping for Droid's mission planner (e.g. 'M1: Auth foundation').

preconditions.description: What must be true before this PRD starts (other PRDs complete, infra available, etc).

expected_behavior.description: BDD scenario block (Given/When/Then) or reference to the PRD's BDD section. Semantically aligned with Factory features.json `expectedBehavior` field.

verification_steps.description: Validation-contract assertion IDs (VC-* pattern). Each ID resolves to a behavioral check in validation-contract.md.

fulfills.description: Validation-contract assertion IDs this PRD claims to fulfill. Often overlaps verification_steps but may be a subset (verification = what we'll check, fulfills = what we promise).

skill_name.description: Free-form skill/agent identifier (e.g. backend-engineer, frontend-engineer, mobile-engineer). Free-form rather than enum to avoid blocking new agent types; emitters may warn on unknown values.

estimated_complexity.description: Coarse sizing. Drives swarm sizing per swarm-orchestration.md.

slices.description: Optional sub-goal decomposition for PRDs too big for a single /goal turn budget. Each slice becomes its own dispatch bundle; slice IDs use the parent PRD id + .letter (e.g. F11.001.a).

proof.description: Measurable success criterion for this slice. Same shape as goal.stopping_condition but slice-scoped.
